mapper.sql: id, subject, application_id, conversation_type, status, create_by, create_time, direct_key, last_message_id, last_message_at, last_message_preview, last_sender_user_id
mapper.select: select from nad_conversation where application_id = #{applicationId} order by id desc

select c.id, c.subject, c.application_id, c.conversation_type, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time from nad_conversation c inner join nad_conversation_participant p on p.conversation_id = c.id where p.user_id = #{staffUserId} and p.role = 'STAFF' and p.removed_at is null
and c.application_id = #{applicationId}
and exists ( select 1 from nad_conversation_participant sp join sys_user su on su.user_id = sp.user_id where sp.conversation_id = c.id and sp.removed_at is null and sp.role != 'STAFF' and (su.nick_name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%') or su.user_name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')) )
order by c.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into nad_conversation (subject, application_id, conversation_type, status, direct_key, create_by, create_time) values (#{subject}, #{applicationId}, #{conversationType}, #{status}, #{directKey}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(x.unread), 0) from ( select (select count(*) from nad_message m where m.conversation_id = me.conversation_id and m.id > coalesce(me.last_read_message_id, 0) and m.sender_user_id <> me.user_id and m.deleted_at is null) as unread from nad_conversation_participant me where me.user_id = #{userId} and me.removed_at is null ) x
mapper.update: update nad_conversation set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
